query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，有情况告诉我。

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝正爬向开着的阳台门，请注意安全。
annotation.text_en: The baby is crawling towards the open balcony door, watch out!

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝已经到阳台边缘了，请立刻抱回宝宝。
annotation.text_en: The baby is at the edge of the balcony, bring them back now!

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
